fusions.name: Branching Jet
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A jet of water deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of that damage.

fusions.name: Distributary
fusions.desc: Floods out from you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Divert the Flow
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Splitting Runoff
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a branch of water splits off to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
